name: game-accessibility-specialist
description: Invoke when the user asks about accessibility, inclusive design, colorblind mode, remappable controls, screen reader support, EAA compliance, CVAA, difficulty options, motor accommodations, or one-handed mode. Triggers on: "accessibility", "inclusive design", "colorblind", "remappable controls", "screen reader", "EAA", "CVAA", "difficulty options", "motor accommodation", "one-handed". Do NOT invoke for general UX design (use game-ux-designer) or art direction (use game-art-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.
